summary: PostMePlex iteration 2 end-to-end testing. Backend: 38/38 pytest cases pass (23 from iter-1 regression + 15 new iter-2). Found and fixed two backend defects: (1) UserPublic Pydantic model was missing the `is_super_admin` field so the login payload silently dropped it — semidiepie was being returned with is_super_admin absent, which would have broken the entire admin-gating flow; added the field. (2) POST /api/conversations/{id}/messages returned a 500 because motor's insert_one mutates the dict with BSON _id and the handler returned that dict — added `msg.pop('_id', None)` (same class of bug as the comments endpoint fix in iter-1). Frontend: all five new flows verified visually on mobile viewport — semidiepie sees the 'Verify accounts' row in Settings and the admin/verify page filters Maria and shows a Verify button; alex does NOT see the row; /messages, /messages/new (search 'maria' finds her), Discover search (returns Gamers section), and /create screen (no 'keys not set' message — Cloudinary env loaded) all work. One UI bug: /messages list renders 'undefined' for last-message preview and 'NaNmo' for timestamp when last_message is null (group with no messages yet). Console warnings from iter-1 persist (shadow*, pointerEvents, expo-notifications on web).

minor.issue: FIXED by tester: UserPublic model lacked `is_super_admin: bool = False` field. Pydantic v2 silently dropped the extra arg passed by user_to_public(), so login responses for semidiepie returned no is_super_admin key. Frontend gates 'Verify accounts' on this flag → would have hidden the entire admin UI. server.py:64-75.
FIXED by tester: returned 500 due to motor's insert_one mutating msg dict with BSON _id. Added msg.pop('_id', None) after insert. server.py:852.

Still logs 401 from upstream when EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY=placeholder. Endpoint now returns 'skipped' (good) but every push trigger inside other handlers (follow/like/comment/DM) still calls the upstream and logs 'Push trigger failed: 401'. Recommend short-circuiting send_push() when PUSH_KEY=='placeholder' to silence noise. server.py:194-207.

ui_bugs.issue: Group conversations with last_message=null render 'undefined' for the preview text and 'NaNmo' for the relative timestamp. Guard with: text = c.last_message?.text || (c.is_group ? 'New squad' : 'Say hi'); and skip formatRelativeTime when updated_at is missing. Visible on /messages for alex (TEST_Squad rows).

Still no testID/data-testid attributes on interactive elements (chat icon, settings icon, send-message button, verify-toggle button, discover-search input, etc.). Selectors are forced to fall back to text content. Reported in iter-1; not addressed.

issues: Clean layout, search + list + orange 'Verify' button. Verified badge appears next to display name after toggle. Touch target on Verify button looks ≥44px.
Layout fine but the 'undefined / NaNmo' empty-preview rendering looks broken.
Admin section is shown only for super-admin (correct). Verify accounts row is well-styled.

Console warning persists on web: '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web.' Guard listener with Platform.OS !== 'web'.
Console warning persists: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:152-166 user_to_public passes is_super_admin to UserPublic — model MUST declare the field, or Pydantic v2 silently drops it. Bug class: 'silent field loss via extra='ignore'.' Consider model_config = ConfigDict(extra='forbid') in dev to catch this earlier.
server.py:838-881 send_message — same insert_one+return pattern as the iter-1 comments bug. Recommend a shared helper `strip_id(doc)` or always re-fetch from db before returning.

rca_of_issue: is_super_admin missing RCA: Pydantic v2 defaults extra='ignore', so when user_to_public(u) called UserPublic(... is_super_admin=u['is_super_admin'] ...) without the field being declared on the model, the kwarg was silently dropped. Confirmed via direct curl to /api/auth/login before fix: no is_super_admin key in user payload. Fix: declare `is_super_admin: bool = False` on UserPublic (server.py:73). Verified post-fix: curl returns is_super_admin=true for semidiepie and the Settings 'Verify accounts' row renders correctly. Messages 500 RCA: motor's insert_one mutates the input dict by assigning the new BSON ObjectId to dict['_id']; the send_message handler then did `return {**msg, 'created_at': ...}` which preserved _id; FastAPI's jsonable_encoder cannot encode ObjectId and raised. Same root cause as iter-1's comments bug. Fix: msg.pop('_id', None) immediately after insert.
